Chapter 252: The War Begins (8)
"What I want is simple. For now, it’s for the insect-like you to survive until the right time."
As soon as he heard those words, Kelliark instinctively recalled Elona Zipple, who had been momentarily freed from the Origin Stone.

-"Please trust me, Jin. The Demon Army's goal isn’t just victory in this world. They don't care if they destroy this world! As long as you and the alliance are no longer a threat to the unified Zipple, any method will do!"
The words Elona had shouted to Jin at the time.
According to her, the Demon Army could abandon this entire world for the sake of the unified Zipple at any time. Including the Zipple of the 677th dimension.
"Does this mean we must survive not just the Vamel Alliance, but also the Demon Army?"

"Yes. You might have only seen the Demon Army as allies, but their leader, the Kelliark Zipple of another dimension, he's a man who rose to the pinnacle of the unified Zipple by devouring and eliminating guys like you. Now that the conquest of all dimensions is at hand, do you think he'd welcome a variable?"
Therefore, to survive, one must be acknowledged for their value by the Unified Zipple.
Kelliark immediately grasped the meaning behind Lokia's words.
"You mean, I need to show that I can fight the Vamel Alliance well even without the Demon Army's help, or I need to possess something that they find useful."
What would the Demon Army need?
It was a difficult question for Kelliark to answer right away, as he had never entered the Demon Army's headquarters.
"The first option is of little use. No matter how well you fight, from the Demon Army’s perspective, it would be easier and safer for them to simply destroy this world."
Of course, since Kelliark couldn't read with his insights, he couldn't fully trust Lokia's explanation about the Demon Army.

‘Lokia wouldn't have a reason to give false information. If she could use the power of the Sun God to further pressure me, she would have continued, but she stopped here, which means there’s something she wants from me. However... she is likely hiding the truth in a clever way.'
Above all, the possibility that Elona Zipple lied to Jin seemed even less likely. For the Demon Army, destruction was certainly the safer choice.
In fact, it was already clear that the Demon Army was not entirely friendly to the Zipple of this world.
“That makes sense.”
“The latter is something I’ll tell you. What they need is only one thing, Kelliark. The complete Sun God.”
“The Sun God?”

“Yes. The Demon Army possesses a large number of completed Origin Stones, but there are a few areas where those alone are not enough. History manipulation alone cannot resurrect the Sun God, and they cannot manipulate the entire world’s time at will.”
“In that case, the Demon Army must also have a way to control the Sun God."

“They probably do. Anyway, what you need to do is simple. When you are able to contact the Demon Army later, tell them this. That this world still has the potential to resurrect the Sun God. If you do, they will confirm the fact and then postpone this world's destruction."
“I understand. Is that all you want?”

“Three more things remain. One, kill more lives. Just like what you did today to the autonomous districts of the former Draca. Well, this is something you would have done even if I hadn't said it. There's no better way to torment my descendant."
“The second?”
“Use the power of the Origin Stone to search the depths of the Black Sea. Find Chiron Runcandel, secure his location…”
Lokia’s reason for searching for Chiron was that there was something she needed to take from him.
Barisada.
A subspace created by Lokia in the Black Sea a thousand years ago, and the key to entering Solderet's final arrangement. Lokia, too, had something she wanted to confirm there.
“I think I roughly understand now. Why you can't take Malugia out of the Origin Stone.”
“Ha?”

“Lokia Ganesto. Even if you manage to take Malugia out, the Origin Stone won’t be completely destroyed. It worked pretty well even before Elona, it would just regress. But if that happens, you, me, and the entire world will be destroyed by the Demon Army... You must have been troubled, trying to figure out how to lure me out.”

“Don’t try to test me, you insect bastard. You are the culprits who woke me from my dream, and the ones who created the terrible situation of multiple dimensions by indiscriminately using the Origin Stone a thousand years ago."

“If you want to make a deal, at least show some basic courtesy. You can never unleash that old hatred of yours toward the Zipple. You’ve endured for a thousand years, so why would you choose mutual destruction? When you mention Chiron, let me guess the words you didn’t say. You were planning to add your power to the Origin Stone for that purpose.”

It was accurate. Currently, the Demon Stone could only use its power in the Black Sea with the added force of Lokia’s Araxyon. Without Araksyon’s power, using the Origin Stone in the Black Sea would inevitably result in a lack of strength to defend the Tower from the Vamel Alliance.
"The damn bastard is using his head..."

"It's the same for both of us, isn't it? The Zipples and Runcandels were originally meant to bite and be bitten by each other. If the multiple dimensions really started from the Zipples a thousand years ago, you should have stopped it then, huhu... A thousand years have passed, yet here we are still struggling, Lokia Ganesto."
Surprisingly, Lokia shrugged her shoulders with calm eyes.
“Yeah, it does seem like quite the struggle.”
“First, kill more lives. Second, use the Origin Stone to secure the location of Chiron Runcandel. Now, the final third. What is it?”
“Hand over the body of Airan Vermont.”
“…Ah, that is necessary. If, as you say, the Demon Army truly wants the resurrection of the Sun God as you say, then he must not be annihilated."
Naturally, Kelliark was aware that Bligiet had been captured by the Vamel Alliance.
"Yes, I plan to release Airan's restrictions so that he can use his original power."
“Airan’s restrictions on Bligiet can be lifted without your help. Bligiet said it would take half a year, but a month will suffice.”

"If that guy is held there for a month, who knows what that cutie named Luci will do to him. He will surely be severely damaged, to the point where Kinzelo's complete resurrection becomes impossible. The moment something happens to the egos of the Sun God, do I need to explain again that there will be no reason for the Demon Army to leave this world alone? Airan's restriction is a curse of the ancient Melka tribe. It's a domain that I can resolve without much difficulty."
“I understand. I’ll hand him over immediately.”
With a gesture, Kelliark opened a small dimensional gate in the air, and Airan Vermont, appearing like a dark corpse, fell out.
This was the one moment where Lokia had completely deceived Kelliark. The reason she needed Airan wasn’t for Bligiet.
The fact that Bligiet was damaged had nothing to do with Kinzelo’s complete resurrection. The key to the resurrection of the Sun God wasn’t the preservation of the egos.
What Lokia wanted from Airan’s body was “authentication.”

-“What we need is not royal techniques or hidden secrets. Lord Airan and Lord Bibol themselves have no value. As I said, we only need Temar’s left arm. However, Lord Airan likely took measures so that this left arm cannot be used without his authentication, so we have no choice but to rescue Lord Airan as well.
The words said by the High Priestess of the Sun God cult, Sanna, when she saved Airan in the past.
Lokia, of course, knew the details far better than the destroyed Sun God cult ever could.
There was a condition that had to be met in order to enter Solderet's final arrangement in the Black Sea, the subspace created by Lokia.
The key called Barisada, and the body of Temar that could use it.
From the moment he obtained Temar's body, Airan Vermont had spent a long time painstakingly placing a curse on that arm. So that no one could use the arm fully without his permission.
The curse that tortured Bligiet was precisely that.
And in Lokia's judgment, that curse could not be removed by any dimension's Origin Stone while keeping Temar's arm intact.
It was because of the will, the power of existence, remaining in Temar's body. If the authority of the Origin Stone was blocked by the power of existence, the left arm would naturally be damaged.
Therefore, one had to use a method to reverse and undo the Melka tribe's ritual. And currently, only two people knew that method.
Lokia Ganesto, and the great serpent Ameris.

‘I've successfully obtained Airan’s body. And as for the left arm of Temar held by the Vamel Alliance... I can probably get it by using Lucy. If Lucy still holds onto the feelings from a thousand years ago, she won’t be able to refuse exchanging her daughter and the deceased Temar’s left arm.’
Hailyn Runcandel, and the ego of destruction, Araxion, within her.
Lokia planned to separate Araxion from Hailyn, then make a deal with Lucy. After all, Hailyn was not dead.

Once the deal was successfully made at the right moment, everything needed to enter Solderet’s arrangement would be complete. The location of the hidden subspace, which even she who created it didn't know because Solderet had hidden it, would be found by Chiron.
Lokia gathered Airan’s body and opened a black dimensional gate.
"Are you leaving now?"

"Yes, don't make any mistakes. If either of us messes up, the Demon Army will wipe this entire world away. And, under no circumstances should you meet Kelliark of the unified Zipple in person. You'd be devoured instantly. He only shares the same name as you; he's a monster on a different level."
“It sounds like you’ve met him in person.”
"I'll just say, pretty much."
"When will you start lending your power to the Origin Stone?"

"From now on. Oh, and I'm saying this because I'm concerned. Don't waste the Origin Stone's power trying to find my hiding place. It'll be tight just using it for battles with the Vamel Alliance and searching the Black Sea. How pathetic would it be to get beaten not by the Demon Army, but by the Vamel Alliance, after wasting your strength on something pointless?"
"I will not forget your advice."
